draft.title: Taccuino del giorno · 5 agosto 2026
draft.excerpt: Movimenti di mercato e prestiti che coinvolgono cinque talenti della prossima generazione azzurra: dal Napoli che chiude un acquisto definitivo, ai giovani in movimento tra Serie C e estero.
draft.excerptEn: Market movements and loans involving five talents of the next generation of Italian football: from Napoli closing a permanent signing to young players on the move between Serie C and abroad.
draft.bodyIt:
**Seydou Fini**
Il Napoli ha ufficializzato l'acquisto del giovane talento a titolo definitivo, un colpo in prospettiva per il presente e il futuro della squadra azzurra. Un'operazione che guarda dritto alle ambizioni mondiali 2030.
[fonte](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiiAFBVV95cUxPMnZOQ2hxeHZ2dTZWY1NPX2d3N0ZmS1JrenlHcWJPSklZeTJuVFhnZk5SQlAwbkQ4cDdpNUJ3ejRCTDhaR0h0M1JpUF8zaW82V2NIbzBacld0ekx3bVFEN0tFUzJtTFItMk5zVTgzdEFQNnZXYzhOUUN5RlgtNUJDTVdDTWV2cmM0?oc=5)

**Tommaso Martinelli**
La Fiorentina ha deciso di mandare ancora in prestito il promettente classe della Primavera, con una scelta strategica pensata per la crescita del giovane. Un passo indietro tattico verso obiettivi più alti nel futuro.
[fonte](https://news.google.?oc=5)

**Davide Pavesi**
La Pergolettese ha ufficializzato il giovane attaccante, pronto a fare il suo debutto tra i "grandi" della categoria. Un'occasione per mettersi in mostra verso palcoscenici sempre più importanti.
[fonte](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMihwFBVV95cUxPVGU4RkNRQTI4TFBsX2VnY25rNnB1OXZvUEI2QXVQXzJ0NFprNjJlNTlSTTVfb1phaHQtbnJtMExxcDJZR1Qwbl91d29RYkxLX0J4VkhDX3JhZzZIOUVfWjV4bGl4Z0pVSnpPNm1IeEpFWWZfUHBtenVqZ0M4TDdpTmxBSFZWVE0?oc=5)

**Christian Comotto**
Il futuro in rossonero del talento milanista rimane incerto tra la possibile conferma in squadra e il rischio di rimanere relegato in panchina. Una situazione che andrà chiarita per garantire la crescita continua verso il 2030.
[fonte](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMifkFVX3lxTE5aNXZUdldlSThGZzdhajdENGktRFF5T3liRjJ4STBUeUJRSDZXTk9LbGZrNUI1R2kyY3RDRmtrNzc4RVFzNWJ2UXpid1pFR1BFOThDSW8wbWlGR3d1VXNCNDVQUnd0dER5Vk95Z3ZvZ1FfdXZCeG1uTnhMSFMzdw?oc=5)

**Luca Koleosho**
L'esterno della Fiorentina, in prestito al Paris FC, ha già collezionato il suo battesimo con i francesi facendo buona impressione. Un'esperienza europea che completa la formazione del talento verso i grandi palcoscenici.
[fonte](https://news.google.?oc=5)
draft.bodyEn:
**Seydou Fini**
Napoli has officially announced the permanent signing of the young talent, a move that looks to the future ambitions of the Azzurri squad. An operation with eyes firmly set on the 2030 World Cup.
[source](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiiAFBVV95cUxPMnZOQ2hxeHZ2dTZWY1NPX2d3N0ZmS1JrenlHcWJPSklZeTJuVFhnZk5SQlAwbkQ4cDdpNUJ3ejRCTDhaR0h0M1JpUF8zaW82V2NIbzBacld0ekx3bVFEN0tFUzJtTFItMk5zVTgzdEFQNnZXYzhOUUN5RlgtNUJDTVdDTWV2cmM0?oc=5)

**Tommaso Martinelli**
Fiorentina has decided to send the promising Primavera prospect out on loan again, a strategic choice designed for the young player's growth. A tactical step back toward bigger objectives ahead.
[source](https://news.google.?oc=5)

**Davide Pavesi**
Pergolettese has officially signed the young striker, ready to make his debut among the "big boys" of the category. An opportunity to showcase himself toward increasingly important stages.
[source](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMihwFBVV95cUxPVGU4RkNRQTI4TFBsX2VnY25rNnB1OXZvUEI2QXVQXzJ0NFprNjJlNTlSTTVfb1phaHQtbnJtMExxcDJZR1Qwbl91d29RYkxLX0J4VkhDX3JhZzZIOUVfWjV4bGl4Z0pVSnpPNm1IeEpFWWZfUHBtenVqZ0M4TDdpTmxBSFZWVE0?oc=5)

**Christian Comotto**
The future of the Rossoneri talent at Milan remains uncertain, caught between a potential squad confirmation and the risk of warming the bench. A situation that needs clarifying to ensure continuous growth toward 2030.
[source](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMifkFVX3lxTE5aNXZUdldlSThGZzdhajdENGktRFF5T3liRjJ4STBUeUJRSDZXTk9LbGZrNUI1R2kyY3RDRmtrNzc4RVFzNWJ2UXpid1pFR1BFOThDSW8wbWlGR3d1VXNCNDVQUnd0dER5Vk95Z3ZvZ1FfdXZCeG1uTnhMSFMzdw?oc=5)

**Luca Koleosho**
The Fiorentina winger, on loan at Paris FC, has already made his debut with the French side making a positive impression. A European experience that rounds out the talent's education toward the biggest stages.
[source](https://news.google.?oc=5)
